design: Whole-state MLP12 replacement mu+P(x-mu), not donor edits. Frozen oldtask128 versus129dimensions with noun anchor or either random residual direction. Fixed old training center for every arm. Identity control. No fitting.
evaluation: All old original-six non-discovery context states, retaining native failures as diagnostic; all80 H1002states with native-gate eligibility; all256 H998confirmation states from64documents, fourpositions each. No original whole-task holdouts evaluated.
metrics: KL(native || reconstructed), native-top1 agreement, centered squared-error ratio. Macro average old native-passing cohorts and natural documents. Natural top1 agreement is fidelity, not ground-truth accuracy.
limits: Dense linear representation; no learned sparse gates. Added dimension and random extensions have matched129dimension size. Reused development panels and natural confirmation are not untouched final tests. Stronger reconstruction geometry does not guarantee lower downstream KL.
